items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The first parade I seen was the last small boy and left... Tash and Newton there.

ctx.x: And would have them on Sunday like they do nowadays. That's right. They usually have them on Sundays.

That's right. They have them on Sundays. The first parade I seen was the last small boy and left... Tash and Newton there. The parade? Yeah. Well, they usually have parades every Sunday. I'm talking about the first parade I seen Tash and Newton. Where, in IJ? Yeah. Well, I never remember no parade in IJ. All the parades most used to be over here.
Well that's with them clubs, but they had parades over there before the bulls and lions and them was up.
